Dear Mr. Patterson:
From February 26 to February 28, 2021, representatives of the Pipeline and Hazardous Materials
Safety Administration (PHMSA), Office of Pipeline Safety (OPS), pursuant to Chapter 601 of 49
United States Code (U.S.C.), investigated Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline’s (SSCGP) Line
FM Rupture Incident near Joplin, Missouri.
As a result of the investigation, it is alleged that SSCGP has committed probable violations of
the Pipeline Safety Regulations, Title 49, Code of Federal Regulations (CFR). The items
investigated and the probable violations are:

 1.

§ 192.493 In-Line inspection of pipelines.
